## Proprietary Multi-Stage Dual-Agent AI Video Pipeline (Architecture)
How Striku inspects videos with 99.4% precision:
1. **Frame-by-Frame Slicing**: Slices video temporally at 1 FPS plus scene transitions in browser memory. Deconstructs audio into acoustic spectrograms. Nothing is missed—even a 1-second background sound loop.
2. **Deep Micro-Analysis (Specialist Agent 1)**: Agent 1 performs microscopic inspection of every frame and audio stem: blade/knife proximity, stunt hazards, unlicensed CapCut background audio samples, and deceptive clickbait thumbnails.
3. **Secondary Adversarial Verification (Agent 2 - Compliance Adjudicator)**: A second independent AI agent stress-tests every flagged moment against YouTube's 2026 Community Guidelines, Content ID algorithmic rules, and US Fair Use legal precedents (17 U.S.C. § 107) to eliminate false positives.
4. **Precision Safe-Cut Recipe**: Outputs millisecond trimming timecodes (e.g. Cut 00:04 - 00:08 in CapCut/Premiere), visual blur masks, and AI counter-appeal letters.

Visible publicly without login at https://www.striku.cloud/#pricing:

### 1. Free Starter ($0/mo)
- **Included (Kia Hai)**: 5 Video Audits/month, Shorts & Reels support (up to 3 mins length), Strike Hazard Risk Score (Critical/Safe), YouTube Policy violation explanations, Zero Video Retention privacy.
- **Locked / Not Included (Kia Nahi)**: Exact millisecond safe cut timecodes (LOCKED), CapCut audio sample sniffer (LOCKED), AI legal counter-appeal kit (LOCKED), Side-by-side compare (LOCKED), Channel tracker (LOCKED).

### 2. Creator Shield ($19/mo, or $190/yr)
- **Included (Kia Hai)**: 25 Video Audits/month, Up to 60 mins length (HD/4K), ALL exact second-by-second CapCut & Premiere safe-cut timecodes UNLOCKED, Dual-Agent 3-pass neural verification, CapCut audio sample sniffer, Downloadable EDL/Cut markers.
- **Locked / Not Included (Kia Nahi)**: AI legal counter-appeal kit (Requires Pro), 2-Video side-by-side compare (Requires Pro), Channel tracker (Requires Pro).

### 3. Creator Pro ($39/mo, or $390/yr) - Full Suite
- **Included (Kia Hai)**: 75 Video Audits/month, Up to 120 mins length, Everything in Creator Shield, 1-Click AI YouTube Legal Counter-Appeal Kit UNLOCKED, Side-by-Side 2 Video Trend Comparison, YouTube Channel Studio Tracker (24h/7d live metrics & strike defense), Priority GPU processing node.
- **Locked / Not Included (Kia Nahi)**: Simultaneous batch queue (Requires Master), White-label client PDFs (Requires Master), 5 team seats (Requires Master).

### 4. Studio & Agency Master ($80/mo, or $799/yr)
- **Included (Kia Hai)**: UNLIMITED Video Audits (zero monthly limits, unlimited 4K/8K length), Simultaneous Batch Queue (20+ videos at once), 5 Team Editor Seats, Exportable White-Label Client PDF Certificates, Direct YouTube Studio API Channel Sync, 24/7 Dedicated Strike Defense Concierge.
